tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i don nyung ngu'i ngag gis gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ brtan g.yo kun khyab gzhom med rdo rje'i sku/ /thog mtha' dbus bral 'gyur med bde ba che/ /sgrib bral yang dag ye shes lam rig pa'i/ /rnam mkhyen 'dren mchog bla ma 'khor lo'i mgon/ /mtshungs med rigs brgya'i gtso bo rdo rje sems/ /brtul zhugs grub pa dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs/ /chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas la gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /sras bcas rgyal ba dges pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /mkhas kun dga' mdzad phrin las bzang po dang / /dpal ldan byang chub sems kyi rdo rje dngos/ /'dren pa mchog des slar yang bdag la srungs/ /gang de'i drin las rtog ge'i yul min pa'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gsang ba zla med pa/ /cha tsam rtogs nas gzhan la phan pa'i blos/ /'chad par 'gyur gyi mkha' 'gros skabs phyes shig /spel legs tshig gi me tog las 'ongs pa'i/ /yid 'phrog don gyi 'bras bu nga nyid ces/ /'khrul med rang zhal ston pa'i ro brgya pa/ /gang 'di ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ /rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos pa bzhi/ /skyabs 'gro gso sbyong gtan khrims sems bskyed bzhi/ /bye mdo rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma bzhi/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med bzhi/ /bzhi bzhi bcu drug rgyu dang rim 'jug lam/ /de rjes sngags lam thog ma smin byed dbang / /lam la rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ /spyod dang nye rgyu mchog gi mngon rtogs lnga/ /bzlas dang gtor ma sbyin sreg rab gnas dang / /las tshogs rab 'byams zhes bya yan lag lnga/ /gnyis ka'i thun mong dam tshig sdom pa ste/ /thabs rgyud mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig go /gnas skabs 'bras bu slob lam sa bcu gnyis/

/mthar thug gnas yongs gyur dang ye shes sku/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das dang gnyis su med/ /mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad dang rnam lnga 'o/ /de ltar mngon rtogs bzhi bcu rtsa lnga las/ /gtan khrims bdun dang dbang gi mngon rtogs bdun/ /so sor phye bas lnga bcu bdun du 'gyur/ /de tshe bzhi dang bcu dang bzhi dang bzhi/ /de bzhin bdun dang lnga dang lnga dang gcig /bcu gnyis lnga ste lnga bcu rtsa bdun ni/ /bshad bya mngon par rtogs pa'i lus yin no/ /'gro sems rang bzhin spros bral chos sku'i dngos/ /'khor 'das kun khyab de bzhin nyid dbyer med/ /rigs khams chos dbyings sbyang rung du yod phyir/ /'gro kun de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can/ /de lta na yang rang gi rang bzhin la/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i lhan skyes ma rig pas/ /bsgribs pa'i dbang gis sems nyid 'od gsal las/ /nyes kun rtsa ba bdag tu snang ba byung / /ngar 'dzin dbang gis chags sogs nyon mongs dang / /de las las gsog las las skye ba sogs/ /yan lag bcu gnyis dbang gis 'khor ba ru/ /rgyun chad med par 'gro ba drug tu 'khor/ /'on kyang sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar/ /myang 'das dbyings su gdod nas dag pa dang / /glo bur dri ma sprin ltar 'bral rung phyir/ /sems nyid thabs kyis sbyangs na grol bar 'gyur/ /chos nyid dbye ba med kyang chos can gyis/ /dbye bas 'bras bu myur bul rtogs bya'i phyir/ /rigs dang spang byar ltos pa'i gang zag dang / /rkyen 'gas cung zad 'gyang yang grol 'gyur zhes/ /des phyir rkyen la ltos pa'i gang zag bstan/ /de ltar rgyu la gnas kyang smin grol gyi/ /lam mchog don du gnyer ba'i blo med na/ /tshe 'di'i spyod yul mi rtag par bstan pas/ /skyo ba bskyed nas rim gyis 'jug pa'i thabs/ /'jigs dang dad pa'i sgo nas skyabs kyi mchog /dkon mchog gsum la snying nas skyabs song ste/ /de yi phan yon yid la nges pa'i blos/

/spyi dang so so'i bslab bya kun la bslab/ /tshul des 'jigs pa kun las skyob nus pa'i/ /skyabs kyi gnas su 'gro phyir skyabs 'gror brjod/ /'di la ston lam grogs su 'dzin pa dang / /so so'i gnas 'dod tshul gyis skyabs 'gro ba'i/ /dbye bas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i skyabs 'gro gnyis/ /'bras skyabs rgyu dang dus dang dgos ched bzhis/ /thun mong thun mong min pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /de ltar skyabs su song ba'i gang zag des/ /dge ba gso zhing sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs/ /bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa legs blangs nas/ /tshul bzhin bsrungs la phan yon ches mang ldan/ /ji srid 'tsho bar tshul khrims srung nus pa'i/ /gling gsum skyes pa'i skyes pa bud med kyis/ /'tshe dang ngan song 'khor ba las mthar phyir/ /skyes dang bud med so so'i bslab pa'i tshig /gzhan gnod gzhir bcas spong ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /rang rang gzhung bzhin len dang gtong ba'i rgyu/ /bsrung tshul phyir bcos dang bcas nges par bya/ /de lta'i skabs su gzhan phan byang chub sems/ /theg chen rigs kyi nus pas rnyed pa 'am/ /gzhan du yongs 'dzin mchog gi bka' drin las/ /dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed blang / /de ltar bslabs pas spyod pa dag gyur nas/ de nas lta ba rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /thog mar bye smra'i gzhung lugs nges bya ste/ /shes bya'i gnas ni phung po skye mched khams/ /sum cu rtsa lnga chos gnyis kyis bsdus pa/ /de yang gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas te lnga/ /gzugs kyi khams na gzugs rdzas nyung mtha' drug /lus dbang ldan la bdun dang gzhan ldan brgyad/ /'dod na dri ro yod phyir nyung mtha' brgyad/ /lus dbang dbang gzhan ldan la rdzas bcu ste/ /sgra dang ldan par skye na bcu gcig go /sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ /de yang gzung 'dzin tha dad dus mnyam pa/

/rnam pas bar du ma bsgribs thug phrad 'dzin/ /sems las byung ba sems kyi sa mang dang / /dge dang nyon mongs chung rnams bcu tshan re/ /nyon mongs che drug mi dge'i sa pa gnyis/ /ma nges brgyad dang bcas pas bzhi bcu drug /brjed nges rnam g.yeng dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /nyon mongs can rdzas yin phyir de gnyis dang / /gti mug med dang lta ba shes bzhin min/ /shes rab rdzas yin phye na lnga bcu gcig /sems dang sems byung rnam med rdzas grub ste/ /bdag rkyen dbang po dang bcas shes pa yis/ /yul rnams rig pa gzhan rig kho nar 'dod/ /mi ldan 'du byed thob dang ma thob dang / /skal mnyam 'du shes med dang snyoms 'jug gnyis/ /srog dang skye gnas rga ba mi rtag pa/ /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs te bcu bzhi 'o/ /nam mkha' gzugs can go 'byed rdzas su yod/ /so sor brtags 'gog gnyen po shes rab kyis/ /spang bya zag bcas bcom pa'i bral rdzas te/ /brtags min 'gog pa rkyen rnams ma tshang bas/ /chos 'ga' skye la gegs byed 'gog gzhan rdzas/ /de bzhin dus gsum dag kyang rdzas su 'dod/ /lam bden ma gtogs 'dus byas zag bcas te/ /zag rnams rgyas par 'gyur phyir sdug kun gnyis/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa snod dang bcud/ /de rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs gnyis/ /las kyi kun 'byung sems pa dang des byas/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin bsam pa ni/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las rnams te/ /nyon mongs kun 'byung rtsa nyon nye nyon no/ /lam gyi dmigs pa sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi/ /shes bya spang bya rig bya bsten bya ste/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa/ /rgyu dang kun 'byung rab tu skye ba rkyen/ /'gog pa bzhi ba gya nom nges par 'byung / /lam dang rigs pa sgrub pa nges 'byin du/ /'phags pas nges phyir 'phags pa'i bden par brjod/ /bcom dang cha shas bsal bas der 'dzin gyi/

/blo mi 'jug pa bum chu sogs kun rdzob/ /bcom dang bsal yang de yi blo 'jug pa/ /phra rab rdul dang skad cig sogs don dam/ /bden pa'i mngon rtogs thog mar tshul khrims bsrung / /de yis thos bsam sngon song zhi gnas bsgrub/ /de nas lhag mthong bskyed phyir lam lngar 'jug /tshogs kyi lam du dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su shes rab kyis brtags te/ /dran pas dmigs pa dag la gtod par byed/ /de lta'i chos dran goms pas bden pa la/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel snang ba phra thob nas/ /'phags lam snga ltas dge rtsa drod thob de'i/ /dmigs rnam bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs ldan/ /de tshe yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus bsgom/ /drod gsum rim bzhin bsgoms pas bden pa la/ /dmigs pa'i zung 'brel rim gyis 'phel ba las/ /dge rtsa g.yo ba'i rtse thob de'i dmigs rnam/ /snga ma dang mtshungs rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsgom/ /rtse mo rnam gsum 'phel las bden pa yi/ /chos nyid cha shas mthong la mi skrag pa'i/ /bzod pa gsum skye de yi chung 'bring gi /rnam pa sngar dang mtshungs te chos dran gyi/ /dmigs pa'i bden pa dag la gtod phyir ro/ /chen po 'dod gtogs sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /skad cig gcig yin dbang po lnga bsgom bya/ /de nas rgyu gzhan med par rang stobs kyis/ /'phags lam 'dren byed chos kyi mchog skye ste/ /dmigs rnam bzod chen dang mtshungs stobs lnga bsgom/ /chos mchog mjug thogs de ma thag pa ru/ /'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs chos shes pa'i/ /bzod pa skye zhing de rjes de nyid la/ /dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes skye bar 'gyur/ /de rjes khams gong sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /rjes bzod rjes shes rim pa bzhin du ste/ /bden pa lhag ma rnams la'ang snga ma ltar/ /dmigs pa'i bzod shes bcu gnyis rim bzhin skye/ /de lta'i bzod pa brgyad ni mthong spang gi

/thob pa gcod la bar chad med lam ste/ /shes brgyad spang bya dang bral thob pa dang / /lhan cig skyes phyir de las rnam grol lam/ /skad cig dang po bco lnga bden pa'i rigs/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam zhes bya/ /phyi ma mthong zin goms byed bsgom lam yin/ /de tshe 'phags lam yan lag brgyad bsgom mo/ /de nas bsgom spang gnyen po bsgom pa'i lam/ /gong 'og sa la zhi rags dmigs rnam can/ /'jig rten pa yi zag bcas bsgom lam dang / /bden pa la dmigs de yi rnam pa can/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i zag med bsgom pa'i lam/ /de tshe byang chub yan lag bdun bsgom mo/ /de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsgom spang spangs pa las thob rnam grol lam/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa 'khor bcas ni/ /mi slob lam ste yan lag bcu ldan no/ /lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag rigs can gsum/ /dang po nyid nas rang rang lam 'jug dang / /nyan thos sngon song sangs rgyas gnyis kyang yod/ /nyan thos myur na tshe gsum dag gis 'grub/ /bse ru bskal brgya byang sems grangs med gsum/ /tshogs bsags srid pa tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten te/ /stan gcig nyid la nges 'byed cha mthun nas/ /brtsams te so so'i byang chub bar skyed byed/ /nyan thos so skye dad dang chos rjes 'brang / /'phags pa skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag brgyad/ /yongs nyams 'chi bar sems dang rjes su bsrung / /gnas las mi bskyod rtogs pa'i skal ba can/ /mi g.yo'i chos can zhes bya dgra bcom drug /shes pa kun rdzob chos rjes gzhan sems shes/ /sdug kun 'gog lam zad dang mi skye shes/ /so skye gcig gnyis mthong bsgom bdun nam brgyad/ /mi g.yo'i chos can bcu ldan sangs rgyas rnams/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje che/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam cha shas gsum gsum dang / /rgyu 'bras phan 'dogs phun tshogs thun mong min/

/thun mong nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi mngon shes drug /mngon shes lnga dang bsam gzugs tshad med bzhi/ /rnam thar zil gnon brgyad brgyad zad par bcu/ /de dag thob byed snyoms 'jug ting nge 'dzin/ /yan lag dang ldan zhi lhag zung 'brel yin/ /bsam gtan snyoms 'jug ces bya der skyes dang / /yon tan rten du de la 'jug pa gnyis/ /dbye na bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /gzugs med yon tan rnams kyi rten yin yang / /yon tan kun gyi rten gyur bsam gtan yin/ /de dag zag med lam gyi ye shes dang / /ldan dang mi ldan sgom pa po'i dbye bas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur/ /'di dag drod nas brtsams te mi g.yo ba'i/ /chos can bar la rim gyis khyad zhugs yod/ /de yi bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten te/ /yul dang 'dus byas mtshan nyid pho mo yi/ /mtshan ma dang bral bdag med stong pa nyid/ /lam yang 'dor phyir smon pa med pa ste/ /ting 'dzin de thob mya ngan 'das zhes bya/ /myang 'das gsum ka rnam grol du 'dra yang / /shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa'i khyad par dang / /rjes thob bsod nams tshogs kyi bye brag gis/ /rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu so sor 'gyur/ /de ltar bye brag smra ba'i gzhung nges nas/ /mdo sde pa yi gzhung lugs rig par bya/ /de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /mdo las bstan bcos gtsor byed rigs min te/ /gsung pa po la gus pa lhod 'gyur zhing / /bstan bcos nyid kyang mdo la brten phyir ro/ /mngon sum rjes su dpag pas grub min pas/ /bstan med thogs med rnam rig min gzugs dang / /mi ldan 'du byed rdzas su yod ma yin/ /'das dang ma 'ongs 'gags dang ma skyes med/ /yod na da lta nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir na rdzas su med/ /phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa ma shar bar/

/dus mnyam thug phrad 'dzin pa'ang rigs min te/ /rnam pa med na sngo ser la sogs pa/ /rtogs tshul so sor dbye bar mi nus phyir/ /de nas rang lugs mdo bzhin 'chad pa la/ /bshad bya gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ /de dag brjod bya'i sgo nas bslab pa gsum/ ston phyir sde snod gsum du 'dus par 'dod/ /rnam rig min gzugs mi ldan 'du byed dang / /chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mched kyi/ /phyogs re ma gtogs phung khams skye mched gzhan/ /mtha' dag 'dir yang rdzas su yod par 'dod/ /ji ltar snang ba shes pa nyid yin yang / /snang ba'i rgyu ni phyi don yin par 'dod/ /gzung 'dzin dus mnyam min phyir rang 'dzin la/ /rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed lkog na mo/ /des na shes pas don dngos ma rig kyang / /rnam pa snang ba'i dbang gis rig par bzhag /de phyir dmigs yul phyi rol don yin yang / /myong ba'i yul ni shes pa nyid yin phyir/ /ngo bo rang rig yin yang phyi rol gyi/ /don dang 'dra bar skyes phyir don rig brjod/ /sems dang sems byung rang gsal skad cig ma/ /mi ldan 'du byed gzugs sems sems byung gi /gnas skabs 'ga' la btags pa tsam du 'dod/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas kyang btags pa tsam/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang dngos por med par 'dod/ /lam dang gang zag rnam dbye phal che ba/ /bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa dang mthun yang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sa bcu dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas la sku gsum la sogs 'dod/ /de dag ston byed mdo sde 'chad tshul ni/ /nyan po gus pa bskyed phyir dgos don bshad/ /gzhung don rags pa rtogs phyir bsdus don bstan/ /bya byed las gsum sbyar la tshig don blang / /snga phyi'i 'brel ba rtogs phyir mtshams sbyar nas/ /rtogs dka'i gnad rnams brgal lan sgo nas bsnyad/ /de ltar mdo sde pa yi lugs shes nas/ /rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug bya ste/

/mdo sde pa rnams rang lugs theg chen du/ /bsgrub phyir sher phyin la sogs theg chen gyi/ /mdo sde phal cher bka' ru mi 'dod kyang / /de yi nyes spong 'di ltar shes par bya/ /ma 'ongs 'jig ltar sngar lung ma bstan zhing / /che chung theg pa ston pas lhan cig gsungs/ /rgyal las gzhan gyis zab rgyas 'di yul min/ /rnam 'phrul gzhan gyis gsung yang bka' ru grub/ /theg chen yod na 'di bas gzhan med cing / /med na mdo sde gzhan la'ang tshul de mtshungs/ /zab rgyas theg pa med na sangs rgyas med/ /theg chen nyon mongs gnyen por 'gyur mthong zhing / /sna tshogs sgra yis gsungs pa rtogs dka' bas/ /theg pa chen po rgyal ba'i bkar grub bo/ /drug gis cig char sbyar sogs rigs pa yis/ /brtags na phyi don rdul phran rnyed ma yin/ /rdul phran mi sbyor 'dus pa sbyor zhe na/ /sbyar rgyu'i rdul phran med phyir de 'dus ci/ /gzugs sogs mngon sum dag dang 'gal zhe na/ /sems nyid 'khrul pa'i snang bar lung las gsungs/ /'ga' las phyi don yod par bshad ce na/ /'jig rten gzhug phyir dgongs pa can du ste/ /de yi dgongs gzhi phyi rol gzugs sogs su/ /snang ba'i rnam rig nyid kyi sa bon dang / /snang ba tsam la dgongs nas gzugs dang ni/ /mig gi skye mched sogs su thub pas gsungs/ /mi ldan 'du byed btags pa tsam du mtshungs/ /'dus ma byas chos med pa kho na'ang min/ /kun gzhi nyon mongs can yid 'jug shes drug /kun 'gro yul nges lnga lnga dge bcu gcig /rtsa nyon nye nyon nyer drug gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ /de dag kun la rig rgyu'i gzugs don gzhan/ /med phyir rang rig nyid yin gzhan rig med/ /shes bya'i gnas dang mtshan nyid de 'jug dang / /de yi rgyu 'bras de rab dbye ba dang / /bslab pa gsum dang de 'bras spangs pa dang / /ye shes theg pa mchog gyur khyad par 'phags/ /shes bya'i gnas ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/

/gang de med na lus len rnam smin myong / /snyoms 'jug las ldang de bzhin 'chi 'pho dang / /skye ba la sogs mi srid skyon yod phyir/ /theg chen mdo sde kun las yod par bstan/ /de la rnam smin kun gzhi zhes bya ba/ /glo bur ma yin thog med dus can khams/ /sngon bsags las kyi bag chags la brten nas/ /kun nyon chos kun skye ba'i gzhir gyur pa/ /dbang shes yul bcas snang ba'i rgyu yin te/ /snga ma'i bag chags las byung 'bras bu'ang yin/ /de la bsgos pa'i kun nyon bag chags ni/ /sa bon kun gzhi zhes bya glo bur ba/ /nus pa tsam las shes rig tu med kyang / /chu dang chu zla lta bur dbye bar dka'/ /de ni kun 'gro dang 'grogs btang snyoms pa/ /rkyen gyis 'gyur phyir ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /des ni reg dang yid byed sogs bsdus nas/ /'khor bar skad cig re re bzhin 'jug la/ /sa bon cha ni nyan rang dgra bcom dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad thob nas ldog /rnam smin kun gzhi nyan rang lhag med dang / /theg chen me long lta bu'i ye shes su/ /gnas gyur tshul gyis ldog ces mkhas rnams bzhed/ /kun gzhi rten cing 'brel 'byung ma rtogs na/ /gcig rtag rang dbang can du 'khrul srid kyang / /du ma mi rtag gzhan dbang can nyid phyir/ /dbang phyug rgyu 'dod sogs dang mtshungs ma yin/ /mtshan nyid gzhan dbang kun brtags yongs grub gsum/ /gzhan gyi dbang ni kun gzhi las byung ba'i/ /yang dag min rtog khams gsum pa'i shes rig /bag chags stobs kyis phung khams skye mched sogs/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par snang ba gang / /kun brtags don la med kyang rnam rig tsam/ /de la rtog pas bdag dang chos la sogs/ /don dang tha snyad du mar sgro btags gang / /yongs grub gzhan dbang rnam rig tsam de nyid/ /don gyi rnam pa dag dang byis pa yis/ /btags pa'i bdag dang gzung 'dzin gyis stong gang /

/gal te phyi don med na rnam rig tsam/ /gzung dang 'dzin par snang ba ci zhe na/ /rnam brdzun pa rnams sna tshogs snang ba 'di/ /bag chags kyis snang rnam pa brdzun pa ste/ /med bzhin snang ba skra bshad 'dzag snang bzhin/ /gnyis med shes pa rnam pa dang bral ba/ /rang rig ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul 'dod/ /de phyir sangs rgyas thob tshe rnam pa dang / /bral ba'i rang rig 'ba' zhig bden par bzhed/ /rnam bden pa rnams sems nyid der snang phyir/ /rnam par snang ba sems su bden pa ste/ /sangs rgyas thob tshe 'di dag gnas gyur nas/ /dag pa'i snang ba nyid du 'gyur zhes zer/ /'di la gzung 'dzin sgo nga phyed tshal dang / /gzung 'dzin sna tshogs gnyis med smra ba dang / /gzung 'dzin rnam pa grangs mnyam du 'dod dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / /yid shes gcig gi ngo bor bden 'dod sogs/ /rnam bden pa nyid grub mtha' mang na yang / /gzung 'dzin rnam pa dus mnyam gcer phrad 'dzin/ /gnyis med ye shes don dam myang 'das dang / /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang 'khrul pa 'khor bar 'dod/ /de rnams mdo sde'i lung dang dngos gcig nyid/ /du mar snang ba'i rigs pas phyi don 'gog /bag chags sa bon las skyes skad cig las/ /mi sdod phyi ma skye de gzhan gyi dbang / /de la ming dang rgyu mtshan la sogs pa/ /phyin ci log tu brtags pas kun brtags pa/ /rnam rig de las don gyi rnam pa sogs/ /gzhan du grub pa med cing de nyid du/ /yongs su grub phyir yongs grub ces byar brjod/ /ma dag dag pa'i gzhan dbang rnam pa gnyis/ /rim bzhin byis pa rnams kyi gnyis snang dang / /'phags pa'i rjes las thob pa'i gnyis snang ngo / /kun brtags ngo bo khyad par kun rtog gam/ /ming la don dang don la ming du rtog /ming la ming dang don la don du rtog /gnyis ka la brten gnyis kar rtog pa 'o/ /yongs grub 'gyur med phyin ci ma log gnyis/

/rang bzhin dri med thob pa dang po ste/ /dmigs pa'i rnam byang zhes bya phyi ma yin/ /de don rtogs phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ma zhum spangs pa zhi lhag gsum gyis 'jug /thos pa'i sgo nas ming don ngo bo dang / /khyad par btsal bas de dag ma dmigs par/ /don kun brjod pa tsam du legs rig nas/ /rnam rig tsam du chos kun shes par byed/ /rnam rig 'du shes ldog nas chos kyi dbyings/ /gnyis kyi mtshan nyid bral ba mngon du byed/ /byang sems 'jug pa'i gnas skabs lam lnga ste/ /mos spyod gnyis dang mthong bsgom mthar phyin lam/ /de yi rgyu 'bras pha rol phyin pa drug /mi mthun phyogs kyi sgo nas grangs nges bzhag /rgyu 'bras dman mchog rags dang phra ba'i rim/ /chags dang gdung ba kun 'khrugs le lo med/ /rtse gcig sems dang chos rab rnam 'byed blo/ /de dbye rab dga' la sogs sa bcu la/ /phyin drug thabs dang smon lam stobs ye shes/ /'di dag mos spyod rtogs dang grub pas thob/ /myur na grangs med gsum gyis de mthar phyin/ /lam mthar phyin byed bslab gsum nyan thos las/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab spyod/ /thos pa'i bag chags goms las nyon mongs kun/ /rim gyis phri bas ma dag gzhan dbang gi /mtshan ma 'gags pas srid la mi gnas shing / /de bzhin shes bya'i sgrib pa yongs spangs pas/ /rnam byang shin tu rnam dag de kho na/ /dag pa'i gzhan dbang nyid du gnas gyur pa/ /ma 'gags phyir na zhi la yongs mi gnas/ /de yi ye shes phun tshogs sku gsum ste/ /spros kun bral ba rang gi dbyings brnyes pas/ /chos rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ngo bo nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku chos sku la brten te/ /zhing sbyong ba dang byang sems smin par mdzad/ /de bzhin sprul pa'i sku yang chos sku la/ /brten te mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pas/ /nyan thos la sogs gtso cher smin mdzad nyid/

/de lta'i sku gsum nyid kyi ngo bo 'am/ /mtshan nyid kho na chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /gang de tshogs gnyis yongs su mthar phyin nas/ /bsgom lam rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /sgrib kun bcom ste mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /de tshe kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas gyur nas/ /chos skur gyur pas dbang 'byor lnga thob ste/ /gzugs phung gnas gyur zhing dbyangs mtshan dpe sogs/ /de bzhin tshor bas zag med bde ba la/ /'du shes ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs bstan pa/ /'du byed sprul bsgyur 'khor dang chos bsdu ba/ /rnam shes ye shes bzhi la dbang 'byor thob/ /phyin drug rdzogs pas dkar po'i chos kyi gzhi/ /tshe sems yo byad las dang skye ba dang / /mos pa smon lam rdzu 'phrul ye shes dang / /chos la dbang ba zhes bya rnam bcu thob/ /yod dang med dang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /gcig min mang po min phyir gnyis su med/ /rtag tu de bzhin nyid las 'gyur med phyir/ /thugs rjes smon lam zad par mi nus phyir/ /'gro don mdzad pa yongs su ma rdzogs phyir/ /rang bzhin rgyun mi 'chad dang rgyun gyis rtag /shin tu rnam dag de bzhin nyid gang de/ /so so rang gis rig par bya ba dang / /srid na dpe med rtog ge'i yul min phyir/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gzhan gyis bsam mi khyab/ /tshad med rnam thar zil gnon la sogs pa/ /bsam yas yon tan yang dag brnyes pa ni/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes phun tshogs zhes bya ste/ /dri med gzhung bzang gzhan las shes par gyis/ /de ltar dngos smra'i them skas la brten nas/ /mtha' bral dbu ma'i khang bzang der 'jug bya/ /de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /rang rig rang gsal shes pa skad cig ma/ /yod ces smra ba kun rdzob tu yod na/ /sgro btags tshul las rang gi mtshan nyid kyis/ /yod pa min phyir kun brtags las ma 'das/ /dam pa'i don du yod na yod pa'i mthar/ /lhung phyir mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam min 'gyur/

/gal te khyed kyang med par 'dod pa'i phyir/ /med pa'i mthar lhung zhe na kho bo cag /kun rdzob ji ltar snang tsam don dam du/ /gang du'ang 'dod pa med pas skyon yod min/ /yongs grub spros bral gzhan dbang la yod na/ /de la yod par 'dzin pa zlog mi nus/ /skad cig tsam du bden par yod ce na/ /de la skye ba la sogs yod med brtag /med na snga phyi'i bar du mi gnas 'gyur/ /yod na yod pa rgyu dang rkyen la ltos/ /gzhan du med pa nyid dam rtag par 'gyur/ /snga ma ltar na rtsa ba'i grub mtha' nyams/ /rtag pa yin na gnas gyur 'dod pa 'gal/ /kun rdzob tu 'gyur zhe na ri rwa la'ang / /gnas gyur yod pa 'gyur zhes cis mi mtshungs/ /rang bzhin yod pa rgyu rkyen la ltos na/ /gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes/ /de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin/ /rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa nyid/ /gang gis stong nyid shes de bag yod yin/ /zhes gsungs phyir na yod pa 'thad ma yin/ /rang lugs kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam gzhag la/ /'ga' zhig 'jig rten grags pa'i bden rdzun dang / /mthun par yang dag log pa'i kun rdzob 'dod/ /gzhan dag kun rdzob shes bya'i gzhi lngar 'byed/ /'ga' las dngos kun sgyu ma lta bur bstan/ /kha cig yul dang yul can rnam bcas 'dod/ /phal cher phyi nang chos kun rmi lam ltar/ /sems nyid bag chags 'khrul pa'i snang bar bzhed/ /de sogs kun rdzob 'dod tshul mang na yang / /dam pa'i don la mi mthun 'ga' med de/ /kun kyang rang rang lugs kyi kun rdzob kyi/ /bden par btags pa'i btags don rigs pa yis/ /dpyad cing btsal bas ci yang ma rnyed pa/ /de la dam pa'i don gyi bden pa zhes/ /ming gis btags pa tsam du mthun phyir ro/ /mdor na so skye'i blo nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes bar gyi chos can sna tshogs su/ /snang ba gang yin de dag kun rdzob ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis 'dus byas dngos nyid phyir/

/de rnams rang bzhin don dam bden pa ste/ /skye ba la sogs kun dang bral phyir ro/ /de ni gzhan la ltos te mi bslu bas/ /bden pa gcig pu zhes kyang skabs 'gar bshad/ /de nyid dngos dang dngos med kyang min te/ /dngos dang dngos med la sogs mthar 'dzin pa/ /zad cing zhi ba mya ngan 'das zhes gsungs/ /myang 'das dbyings ni spros pa dang bral yang / /srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas zung du 'jug /'ga' zhig phyi rol don du zhen pa dang / /stong par zhen pa bsal phyir sems tsam bstan/ /dngos 'dzin spyi dang sems su 'dzin pa yang / /bsal phyir dbu ma'i mdo rnams gsungs pa'i phyir/ /theg chen mdo sde kun gyi nges don la/ /'ga' yang khyad par med ces bshad pa'ang yod/ /de ltar thun mong theg pa la bslabs nas/ /thun mong min pa'i dang po bya rgyud la/ /smin byed gtso bo chu dang cod pan dbang / /thob nas rig sngags 'dul ba la bslabs te/ /yi dam spyan drangs bzlas brjod grogs bcas kyis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bsgrub pa 'o/ /spyod rgyud smin byed chu dang cod pan dang / /rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang thob nas/ /gtsang sbrar ldan pas rang nyid lhar bsgoms te/ /mdun du lha bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la/ /mchod dang bzlas pa la sogs bya ba dang / /dngos grub sgrub dang dngos po'i gnas lugs dang / /de dang rjes 'brel bsam gtan bya ba dang / /gzhan don sgrub pa'i thabs la slob pa 'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du slob ma'i rigs can la/ /rig pa'i dbang tsam byin nas yi dam gyi/ /bzlas bsgom tsam la rim gyis slob pa dang / /rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi rigs yin na/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang yang rab bskur te/ /de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dam tshig dang / /lha dang dkyil 'khor la sogs de nyid bcu/ /slob ma gzhug sogs slob dpon las rnams dang / /dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs sogs slob pa 'o/

/de nas rnal 'byor chen po bla med kyi/ /rgya chen thabs mkhas gtsor ston pha rgyud dang / /zab mo shes rab gtsor ston ma rgyud kyi/ /smin byed bum gsang shes rab ye shes dang / /bzhi pa dbang bskur dam tshig legs byin te/ /grol byed bskyed rdzogs 'khor dang bcas bstan nas/ /de rjes thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /smin grol zab mo'i thabs tshul ston pa ni/ /skal dman sems can dbang po gdul dka' ba/ /rim gyis 'dul bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas so/ /skal ldan mchog gi rigs can skyabs 'gro dang / /byang chub sems bskyed sdom pas bsdoms pa 'am/ /ma bsdams na yang lam mchog snod rung phyir/ /rjes gzung cho gas gang de'i rgyud sbyangs la/ /mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa ci rigs pas/ /yi dam mnyes par byed pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /brtags bslangs sbyangs bzung bsrungs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /sa lha lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams/ /lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga rim bzhin bya/ /de rjes thig dang tshon gyis bri ba dang / /lha yi mtshan ma dgod dang rgyan bkram la/ /sgrub cing mchod nas bdag nyid 'jug sogs bya/ /de nas slob ma 'jug la phyi nang gnyis/ /thun mong dbang drug thun mong min pa bzhi/ /rjes gnang lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod bcas/ /yang na bum dbang bcu gcig gsang dbang lnga/ /shes rab ye shes gnyis dang bzhi pa lnga/ /cig car rim can dbye bas so sor bskur/ /yon dbul dkyil 'khor mchod nas gshegs gsol dang / /rjes bsdu dga' ston bya ba smin byed dbang / /gang de sngon du song nas chos kun gyi/ /gnas lugs spros bral rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /legs par zin pa'i sbyin sogs dge chos rnams/ /rgyal ba'i lam du 'gyur dang dge stobs 'phel/ /log ltas 'phrog pa spang phyir lta ba bsten/ /lta ba zhes bya kun khyab de bzhin nyid/ /chos dang chos can dbyer med lhan cig skyes/

/legs par rtogs pa'i rtog med shes rab ste/ /gang de lung rigs la brten thos bsam dang / /tshig tu brjod pa tsam gyis rtogs min zhing / /dbang las byung ba'i nyams myong ye shes kyis/ /'khor 'das gnyis su med par mtshon nus phyir/ /dbang gi ye shes gang der ngo sprad bya/ /de nyid so so rang rig ye shes te/ /rig bya rig byed dang bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med gnyis min zung du 'jug /rang bzhin kun khyab mtshan nyid du mar snang / /de la log par goms pa'i blo can dag /rang rig ye shes grangs can shes rig dang / /yi ge dam pa rig byed pa yi sgra/ /'gro ba'i bdag nyid bye brag pa yi bdag /srog chags srog ces bya ba gcer pu pa/ /shing sogs bem po la yang bdag 'dod bzhin/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha'/ /med par 'dod pa rgyang 'phen ltar rtog kyang / /dngos kun rang bzhin legs rtogs ye shes de'i/ /rang bzhin spros bral mtshan nyid sgyu ma ltar/ /snang stong zung du 'jug phyir mtshungs ma yin/ /ye shes de la sgro skur spang ba'i phyir/ /de yul bden gnyis nges bya go rim bzhin/ /yang dag don la sgrib byed kun rdzob ste/ /ma brtags rmongs pa'i blo la der bden pa/ /gang de bcos ma'i bden yin don la brdzun/ /dam pas don du gnyer bya don dam ste/ /brtags shing dpyad dang ma rmongs ngor bden pa/ /snga ma la ltos bcos min bden pa 'o/ /chos can mtha' dag kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /gang de'i chos nyid don dam bden zhes bya/ /'on kyang bden gnyis blo la ltos pa'i phyir/ /blo yi rnam dbye nges bya so skye'i blo/ /'khrul pa 'ba' zhig yin phyir kun rdzob pa/ /'phags gsum mnyam gzhag don dam rjes kun rdzob/ /sangs rgyas 'khrul pa zad phyir don dam blo/ /de la rnam grangs rnam grangs min pa dang / /mthun dang mi mthun bden gnyis 'byed pa'ang yod/

/bden gnyis ngo bo'i sgo nas dbyer med pas/ /yang dag de nyid ma mthong 'jig rten pa'i/ /blo tsam bden pa gnyis kyi dbye gzhi ste/ /blo yis gnyis su gzung la ltos phyir ro/ /ma brtags ma dpyad blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ /chos can 'khor ba kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /brtags shing dpyad pa'i blo ngor bden pa'i phyir/ /chos nyid myang 'das don dam bden pa'o/ /gal te don dam blo las 'das she na/ /so skye'i blo yis legs brtags skye med sogs/ /don dam skye ba'i rgyu ste rnam grangs pa/ /'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag ye shes spros bral du/ /rang gis myong la don dam mthong ngo zhes/ /tha snyad dbang gis ming du brjod pa las/ /yul dang yul can tshul gyis rtogs pa min/ /ci ste don dam blo yi yul min na/ /myang 'das bden gcig gang gis rtogs she na/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rtog med brnyes pa'i tshe/ /de la 'khor 'das gnyis snang nub pa'i phyir/ /bden pa gcig pur btags kyi chos can gyis/ /stong pa'i chos nyid logs su grub ma yin/ /de phyir bden gnyis ngo bo dbyer med la/ /sel ngor ldog tshul tha dad nyid du 'dod/ /de ltar phyin ci log dang ma log blo/ /gnyis su nges phyir bden gnyis grangs nges mdzad/ /gang la rigs pas brtags na de 'jig kyang / /ma brtags ngor bden kun rdzob bden pa ste/ dpyod blo gnod med ngor bden don dam gyi/ /bden pa'i mtshan gzhi nges byed tshad ma yin/ /de la rtag chad sgro skur bsal ba dang / /gcig rtag rang dbang can gyi bdag 'gog phyir/ /phung skye khams gsum nyan thos la gsungs gang / /de nyid dgongs pa can du sngar bshad zin/ /de lta'i yul du snang ba ji snyed pa/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang bral phyir/ /ji ltar snang ba de ltar bden ma yin/ /de ltar chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag na/ /snang grags chos rnams gang las byung zhe na/ /sems nyid 'od gsal gcig las yod min yang /

/bag chags dbang gis du mar snang ba tsam/ /de phyir gsal rig 'khor 'das kun gyi rgyu/ /de la ngar sems nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /yul du snang ba'i rnam rig 'jug shes so/ /de ltar snang yang gzung yul gzhan med phyir/ /de la ltos pa'i 'dzin pa yod min pas/ /gnyis kyis stong pa'i shes pa gsal rig tsam/ /de nyid thabs kyis 'gyur bas dgos 'dod kyi/ /'bras bu 'byung phyir rin chen sems zhes brjod/ /de yi rang bzhin skye med nyid yin yang / /gnas skabs rkyen gyis 'gyur phyir gzhan gyi dbang / /gzugs sogs rkyen la ltos phyir ngo bos med/ /de med yul can shes pa'ang rigs min la/ /yul dang yul can med phyir de gnyis kyis/ /stong pa'i shes pa gsal rig yod ma yin/ /kun rdzob chos kun rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed cing / /snang yang ngo bos stong phyir sgyu ma bzhin/ /chos can ngo bos med na de'i chos nyid/ /ji ltar zhe na bsam pa'i yul las 'das/ /gcig dang du ma bral phyir yod ma yin/ /skye la sogs pa mthong phyir med ma yin/ /gnyis ka'i skyon dang bcas phyir gnyis ka'ang min/ /phan tshun ltos phyir gnyis min yang ma yin/ /de ltar gnas lugs nges pa yod min pas/ /nges pa blo yi yul du byar mi rung / /gal te stong nyid ces bya blo nyid la/ /ma ltos ngo bos grub pa yod ce na/ /shes pa med pa'i yul de gang gis rtogs/ /gzhan du bsam mi khyab pa'i bdag cis 'gog /de phyir 'dzin cing mngon par zhen pa kun/ /nye bar len pa'i phung po'i rgyu yin la/ /phung por 'dzin pa yod pa de srid du/ /de la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin sogs 'byung ngo / /de ltar gnas lugs gang du'ang ma grub par/ /shes nas cir yang khas mi len pas na/ /rang tshig 'gal dang tha mal pa mtshungs dang / /lung dang 'gal ba'i klan ka kun dang 'gal/ /yod med mthar 'dzin bzlog phyir stong nyid sogs/ /bshad pa yod kyang gdul bya gzhug phyir yin/

/dgag bya med na bkag pa yod min pas/ /yod pa med na med pa yod ma yin/ /de phyir gnyis dang gnyis min mi 'grub pas/ /mtha' bzhi bkag pa'i mtha' bral gang nas btsal/ /de ltar 'dzin pa kun bral lta ba la/ /nges pa rnyed nas bsgoms pas nyams len tshe/ /yul can gsal ba snying rje chen po nyid/ /mtha' bral yul gyi rnam par legs shar ba'i/ /snang ba snang stong shes pa gsal stong dang / /ngo bo bde stong dbyer med zung du 'jug /de nyid dam pa'i don du bsam bya las/ /nges par 'das phyir bsam pa'i yul ma yin/ /'on kyang kun rdzob tsam du rnam rtog gis/ /dpyad cing bsgoms pas rtog med skye 'gyur te/ /sems su dmigs pas phyi don ma dmigs shing / /de ma dmigs pas sems kyang ma dmigs la/ /de las gzung dang 'dzin pa ma dmigs pa'i/ /bdag med mtha' bral stong pa'i mtshan nyid skye/ /de nyid rtogs na shin tu don che bar/ /gzigs nas thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du/ /dngos dang brgyud pas rtogs bya'i dam pa zhes/ /mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bsngags par mdzad/ /tshul de pha rol phyin pa'i thos bsam la/ /sogs pa'i thabs kyis rtogs min de las gzhan/ /bla ma mnyes dang skyon med dbang dus dang / /thabs mkhas sbyor bas phyag rgya bsten pa dang / /bsod nams tshogs las rnyed 'gyur gang de yi/ /ngo bo rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes che/ /mtshan nyid bden 'dzin rtog pa yang dag spangs/ /de yi rten ni lus can thams cad kyi/ /phung khams skye mched la khyab kun bdag nyid/ /chos can lus la gnas kyang lus skyes min/ /yang na ngo bo zhu bde'i ye shes che/ /mtshan nyid glo bur rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /de yi rten ni lus te dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /zhu bde mi rtog ye shes lus kun bdag /lus la tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'brel pa yis/ /gnas kyang brgyud de skye yi dngos su min/ /gang de mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes te/

/rang rig ye shes rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /byad bzhin blta la me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /don gyi ye shes min yang don dang 'dra/ /de nyid lus la brten nas rtogs pa'i phyir/ /lus kyi rang bzhin nges bya 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' snang mched thob/ /rim gyis thim ste 'od gsal zhes bya ba/ /skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings su zhi ba la/ /'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku zhes brjod/ /slar yang de las ldang 'dod dang 'grogs pa'i/ /srog 'dzin me mnyam khyab byed ma rig pas/ /mngon par bcings pa'i rta la sems zhon te/ /bar dor brdzus te skye ba'i lus blangs nas/ /skye gnas 'tshol la mngon du phyogs par 'gyur/ /skye tshe sems nyid g.yos pas rlung 'byung zhing / /rlung gis bskyod pas drod 'byung drod las rlangs/ /rlangs pa'i brlan gsher brtas pas sa grub ste/ /de las lus dang ngag 'byung gnas pa'i tshe/ /sems ni rlung dang rlung ni rtsa la brten/ /gal te 'byung ba bzhi las lus skye na/ /phyi don yod 'gyur zhe na sa chu me/ /rlung las skye zhing rlung yang sems nyid las/ /skye bar phyag chen thig le sogs las bshad/ /ci ste sems nyid gang las skye zhe na/ /sems ni 'od gsal zhes bya chos kyi dbyings/ /skye 'gag med pa nyid las tha dad du/ /snga ma'i kun gzhi 'gags pa'i nyer len gyis/ /skye bar snang la 'od gsal las skye zer/ /de ltar snga ma'i shes pa phyi ma ru/ /'phos pa med phyir rtag par mi 'gyur la/ /shes pa snga ma'i rgyun la ma brten par/ /phyi ma 'byung ba min phyir chad pa'ang min/ /de phyir las dang rgyun gyi skye ba la/ /rten 'brel dbang gis skye zhes dpe yis bstan/ /mdor na snga ma'i kun gzhi 'od gsal la/ /thim nas snga ma'i las kyi bag chags dang / /kun gzhi'i rgyun la brten nas 'od gsal las/ /kun gzhi phyi ma ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /skye la stong chen zhes bya de nyid las/

/bdag tu 'dzin pa nyon mongs can gyi yid/ /shin tu stong pa skye ste de las kyang / /sngon gyi bag chags kyis bskyed yul rkyen gyis/ /rnam shes tshogs drug stong pa'i bdag nyid skye/ /de gsum rim bzhin thob mched snang ba yin/ /rmongs pas rgyu byas las kyis rkyen byas te/ /rnam shes de ltar skyes nas ming gzugs sogs/ /yan lag bcu gnyis 'byung ste de yang ni/ /rnam shes g.yos las rlung sogs 'byung ba bzhin/ /de las phung khams skye mched skye bar snang / /skye gnas rdzus skyes sgo nga las skyes dang / /drod gsher skyes dang mngal nas skyes pa bzhi/ /de las phyi ma skabs 'dir bshad bya ste/ /pha ma'i rtsa sgo la brten khu khrag dang / /bar do'i rnam shes rlung gis der bskyod dang / /gsum ka'i sngon las mnyam par bsags pa las/ /khu khrag sems gsum bde bar ro mnyam zhing / /pho mor skye 'gyur las dang pha ma la/ /chags sdang rkyen gyis so so'i lus len 'gyur/ /de la dngos dang dngos med sems gsum dang / /lus ngag yid gsum khu khrag dang ni rlung / /rdul mun snying stobs sogs las skye zhes pa/ /phal cher snga ma'i phyogs re tsam la dgongs/ /de lta'i khu khrag rlung sems 'dres pa las/ /rnam shes brgyal thabs lta bur gnas pa'i tshe/ /mer mer sogs 'byung zla ba dang po la/ /gnas 'jug ldang ba'i rlung gis rtsa gsum grub/ /de tshe nya dang gnyis par rus sbal mtshungs/ /gsum par phag rgod lta bur mgo mtho zhing / /bzhi par gdong pa dgra satwa'i dbyibs 'dra dod/ /lnga par dga' byed lta bur tshigs rnams gsal/ /drug par nag pa zhes bya skra spu gnag /bdun par seṅge lta bur mgo bo che/ /brgyad par mi 'u thung ltar lus dod 'gyur/ /dgu par ngang pa zhes bya phyir 'byung 'dod/ /bcu par sangs rgyas sa bcu rdzogs pa ltar/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs rdzogs te btsa' bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rtsa gsum de bzhin sum cu gnyis/

/brgya dang nyi shu stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /ba spu'i bu ga'i grangs snyed rim gyis grub/ /yi ge a dang de bzhin e wam̐ gnyis/ /sde tshan thog ma khams kyi bcu drug dang / /yi ge nyer bzhi hūm̐ brgyad bhūm̐ ām̐ sogs/ /'pho ba'i yi ge la sogs bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub sems ni dbu ma'i yas mar du/ /pha dang ma las thob pa'i khu khrag gnyis/ /ro rkyang lte ba man chad bzhir gyes pa'i/ /rkyang ma'i mdun rgyab dri chu khu ba 'phen/ /ro ma'i rgyab mdun dri chen rak+ta 'phen/ /sha chen dwangs ma kun gyi stobs kyis 'dzin/ /de dag la brten khrag sogs bcu drug dang / /so dang sen mo sogs bskyed sum cu gnyis/ /de la dbang byed rlung ni 'byung chen gyi/ /khongs su gtogs pa sna tshogs byed pa'i gzhi/ /sa chu me rlung nam mkha' shes pa'i rlung / /ye shes rlung ni gnas shing rnam rtog 'gog /las rlung 'gro 'ong byed cing rnam rtog skyed/ /mnyam gnas srog 'dzin gyen rgyu thur sel dang / /khyab byed sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rim/ /lte snying mgrin pa 'doms dang spyi bor gnas/ /rgyu ba mig dang mnyam rgyu rna ba gnyis/ /yang dag rgyu sna rab tu rgyu ba lce/ /nges par rgyu zhes bya ba tshigs la ste/ /rim bzhin sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams/ /klu dang rus sbal rtsangs pa lhas byin dang / /gzhu rgyal ming gis gzhag dang mchin pa dang / /glo snying mkhal mar gnas zhes 'ga' las bshad/ /de ltar bcu char 'byung lnga'i bdag nyid de/ /lus len rim gyis rgyas dang 'dzin pa dang / /sna tshogs rnam rtog skyed cing 'chi bar byed/ /srog gis lus sems gnas dang sna sgor rgyu/ /thur sel gyis ni bshang gci 'phen dang sdom/ /mnyam gnas kha zas 'ju dang dwangs ma 'grems/ /gyen rgyus smra dgod skyug dang kha zas 'phul/ /khyab byed 'degs 'jog 'gro 'ong la sogs byed/ /yan lag rlung rnams mig sogs lam rgyus nas/

/gzugs sogs yul rnams rig pa'i grogs byed do/ /de ltar srog 'dzin ma gtogs gzhan dgu po/ /rang rang las byed de la rgyu bar btags/ /srog 'dzin dang por a wa dhū ti la/ /gnas pa ye shes rlung yin ngar 'dzin pa'i/ /dbang gis snying gar srog 'dzin du gyur nas/ /ro rkyang nus pas srog rtsol zhes bya ba/ /ldang 'jug gnas par sna yi lam nas rgyu/ /ye shes rlung zhes bya ba dus 'khor las/ /drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga zhag re la/ /rgyu bar bshad cing phreng bar thun mtshams sam/ /kun la khyab pa'i tshul gyis rgyu bar gsungs/ /nam mkha'i rlung yang kun la khyab pa 'am/ /'khor gyi tshul gyis rgyu zhing 'chi ba'i tshe/ /gzhan rnams 'di yis dbang byas rgyu zhes bshad/ /de rnams 'byung ba so so'i kha dog can/ /mgon po re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhir ldan/ /me rlung g.yas nas steng du sor bzhi dang / /rlung gi rlung ni g.yon nas sor drug ngos/ /sa rlung thad kar bcu drug gnyis ka nas/ /de bzhin chu rlung 'og tu sor bcu gnyis/ /re re'ang nyis brgya nyi shu lnga lnga rgyu/ /srog 'dzin srog dang rtsol ba nas byung ste/ /snying ga'i 'dab bzhir 'byung ba bzhir byas nas/ /'khor lo bzhi dang yul chen nyer bzhi sogs/ /kun tu rgyus nas 'byung bzhi'i bdag nyid du/ /mgrin par 'byung ba gsung gi sgo bzhi dang / /sna sgo nas 'byung thugs kyi sgo gnyis dang / /yan lag rlung sogs bu ga dgu po nas/ /so sor rgyu ba sku yi sgo dgu yin/ /de ltar sna sgo gnyis nas rgyu ba'i rlung / /ldang 'jug gnas gsum bsdoms pa zhag re la/ /nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtag par rgyu/ /de ltar 'ong ba'ang snga ma'i bag chags ni/ /sems la gnas pa lus la smin pa ste/ /de yi dbang gis phyi nang dus sogs snang / /de yang mkha' phreng dgongs pas zhag re la/ /yul chen nyer bzhi'i dbang gis dgu brgya phrag /nyi shu rtsa bzhi mgon po'i rlung rgyu zhing /

/mgon po re re'ang lha mo bzhi bzhi'i rlung / /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rtsa lngar ldan/ /de lta'i dgu brgya phrag re 'pho ba phyed/ /de bzhin stong dang brgyad brgya 'pho ba gcig /'pho ba bcu gnyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig ste/ /de nyid nang gi lo yin 'pho ba ni/ /nang gi zla gcig 'pho phyed bgrod pa 'o/ /dgyes rdor ltar na lte ba'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbang gis zhag rer dbyug gu drug cu bzhi/ /dbyug gu re la rlung sbyor sum brgya dang / /phyed bcas sum cu rtsa brgyad legs par rgyu/ /spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis chu tshod ste/ /chu tshod re la drug brgya bdun cu lnga/ /mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis 'pho ba ste/ /re re'ang stong dang sum brgya lnga bcu'i tshad/ /snying ga'i rtsa 'dab dbang gis thun phyed brgyad/ /thun phyed re la nyis stong bdun brgya re/ /snying ga'i nang skor dbang gis thun bzhi ste/ /thun re la yang lnga stong bzhi brgya re/ /dbyug gu la sogs rang rang grangs bshad pa/ /gang yin de de rdzogs pa zhag re ste/ /rlung sbyor nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'o/ /de ltar shes nas man ngag ldan pa yis/ /nang du bzung na zhi gnas ting 'dzin skye/ /srog rtsol bgrangs pas sgrib pa 'dag par 'gyur/ /rlung bzhi rgyu dus las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub/ /las rlung ye shes rlung 'gyur 'tshang rgya 'o/ /de ltar de nyid lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /nyams blang gtso bo sgrub pa po yi yid/ /mtshan rtog las skyob thabs kyi khyad par gang / /grol byed lam ste bskyed dang rdzogs pa gnyis/ /lus bskyed lhar bskyed mchog la brod pa bskyed/ de lta'i rim pas rgyud gsum bskyed pa'i rim/ /lus rdzogs rdzogs pa gsal 'debs mchog rdzogs byed/ /de lta'i rim pas rgyud gsum rdzogs pa'i rim/ /spang bya tha mal rnam rtog lhar zhen spong / /thob bya gzugs dang chos kyi sku 'thob byed/

/ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ /lam gyi gtso bo rim pa gnyis su nges/ /'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu ni las nyon te/ /mi dge'i las kyi gnyen po bsod nams tshogs/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba lhan skyes ma rig pa/ /de yi gnyen po stong nyid ye shes tshogs/ /spang bya'i nyon mongs rnam rtog las byung zhing / /rnam rtog de yang thog med 'khor ba nas/ /bag chags bsags pas dbye ba dang 'phrad pa/ /med bzhin snang ba bdag dang bdag gi ba/ /kun tu rtog pa'i dug yin de las gzhan/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhes bya yod ma yin/ /gal te rnam rtog kho na bskyed rim gyi/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor sbyang gzhi rigs min te/ /sems las gzhan pa'i gzugs sogs la brten nas/ /'khor ba'i rgyur 'gyur du ma yod ce na/ /gzugs sogs snang ba sems nyid bag chags kyis/ /dkrugs pa'i dbang gis du mar snang ba las/ /gzhan pa'i gzung 'dzin snang ba yod min te/ /bdag sgrub pa yi rab tu byed pa las/ /rnam rtog las gzhan 'khor ba zhes bya ba/ /'ga' yang yod min de phyir rnam rtog nyid/ /bral bar gyur la mya ngan 'das zhes brjod/ /zhes gsungs phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ /gang gi phyir na ye shes sku spangs nas/ /phyi rol don zhes bya ba ci phyir gnas/ /phyi yi snang ba thams cad skad cig ma/ /dga' mo sems kyi cho 'phrul yin zhes gsungs/ /de lta'i tha mal snod du snang ba kun/ /sbyong byed gzhal yas khang dang lha yi gdan/ /bcud kyi skye gnas sbyong byed bskyed chog ste/ /mngon byang las bskyed mngal dang drod gsher skyes/ /'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pas mngal skyes dang / /cho ga gsum dang thig les sgong skyes sbyong / /skad cig sa bon las bskyed rdzus skyes sogs/ /gzhan yang ye shes tshogs kyis 'chi srid dang / /bar srid mtshon byed rnams kyis bar do sbyong / /rten dang brten pa bskyed pas skye ba dang /

/ye shes gzhug sogs skyes nas gnas pa sbyong / /de dag rim bzhin chos longs sprul pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i sku rnams lam byed do/ /lha sku khro chags can bsgom zhe sdang dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor 'dod chags dang / /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur bsgom gti mug sbyong / /spang bya gnyis pa gya nom lhar zhen gyi/ /gnyen por gyur pa rdzogs rim ye shes te/ /gang des spros bcas kun dang snod bcud dang / /rten dang brten pa 'jig sogs thams cad sbyong / /'bras bu gzugs sku 'thob byed bskyed rim ste/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas thar pa cha mthun sgrub/ /srung 'khor bdud btul pho brang zhing sbyong ba/ /lhar bskyed sangs rgyas dbang sogs der dbang thob/ /spro bsdus don mdzad bzlas pas chos 'khor bskor/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu bas mya ngan 'da' tshul ston/ /spyod lam la sogs mdzad pa phrin las so/ /de bzhin chos sku thob byed rdzogs rim ste/ /thabs gnyis las byung zung 'jug ngo bo nyid/ /chos skur mos shing bsres nas bsgoms pa las/ /'bras bu chos sku 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur phyir/ /gal te rdzogs rim bsgoms pas bskyed rim yang / /sbyong zhing chos sku mngon du byed nus na/ /bskyed rim don med ce na rdzogs rim gyi/ /nyams len de ltar bzang yang de yi rten/ /bskyed rim med na brten pa rdzogs rim med/ /de phyir lha sku med par bde mi 'byung / /'khor ba'i chos rnams de bzhin gshegs rigs te/ /lam gyis sbyangs pas de 'bras 'byung phyir ro/ /de bzhin lam dang 'bras bu'ang rgyu rigs dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu'ang lam gyi rigs su brjod/ /'on kyang lam gyi skabs su rgyu lam rigs/ /'bras bu rigs kyi bdag po zhes bya ste/ /de gsum 'brel pa can du grub pa'i phyir/ /des na rim gnyis bsgoms pas grol 'gyur te/ /zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu'i phyir/

/de bzhin lha dang phyag mtshan dkyil 'khor dang / /bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor rgyur bcas rdzogs rim gyi/ /las brgya la sogs 'bras bu'i rigs yin no/ /brtan pa'i dug gis g.yo ba'i dug 'joms ltar/ /tha mal rnam rtog lam gyi rtog pas 'joms/ /rlung nad chung ngu mon sran gyis bzlog ltar/ /snod bcud gnyen por bskyed rim bsgom pas bzlog /chu nyung mang po'i grogs kyis 'gugs pa ltar/ /bzhin lag gcig zhen gnyen por du ma bsgom/ /tshig pa bsreg dpyad sogs kyis 'chos pa ltar/ /'dod chags gnyen por lha mo'i 'khor bsgom sogs/ /mdor na rnam dag lta ba dang ldan pas/ /dngos po'i mtshan mas mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /bskyed rim bsgom pas 'dod yon lam du byed/ /rdzogs rim thabs kyis nyon mongs byang chub 'gyur/ /dngos rnams rang bzhin skye med de bzhin nyid/ /kun rdzob lus su snang ba lha so so/ /sems nyid du mar snang ba rang rig pa/ /rang bzhin rnam dag rgyu yi dag pa gsum/ /spros bral lam byed lta ba de bzhin nyid/ /dngos kun lha skur bsgom pa lha so so/ /bde chen ye shes rtogs byed rang rig pa/ /dri ma sbyong byed thabs kyi dag pa gsum/ /bral 'bras ngo bo nyid sku de bzhin nyid/ /gzugs sku 'gro ba'i don mdzad lha so so/ /chos sku ye shes mthar phyin rang rig pa/ /mngon gyur 'bras bu'i dag pa rnam pa gsum/ /yang na ngo bo nyid sku rang rig dang / /chos sku de bzhin nyid ces gsung ba'ang yod/ /rim gnyis bskyed rim brtan nas rdzogs rim ni/ /bsgom par bzhed pa 'phags pa yab sras sogs/ /yang na bcu gnyis bar du bskyed rim dang / /de nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa sems 'brel lugs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs bskyed rim la/ /rdzogs rim rgya yis btab nas bsgom par gsungs/ /ga ya dha ra la sogs gong ma rnams/ /bskyed rdzogs stan thog gcig tu bsgom par bzhed/

/dbang thob dam tshig ldan zhing man ngag gi /bka' lung thob pa'i sgrub pos dben pa dang / /rang khyim dur khrod rigs mthun gnas sogs su/ /mtshan mo'i dus sam thun gsum thun bzhi dang / /mnyam rjes kun tu gzhan don bsam pa yis/ /lha yi rnal 'byor bsgom bya de'i ngo bo/ /rnal 'byor gang la rnam dag khyad par can/ /yod pas tha mal snang zhen sbyong nus pa'i/ /lha yi rnal 'byor nyid yin rtsa rgyud las/ /sku gsung thugs dang snying po kye rdo rje/ /yum dang rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang ste drug /rdo rje gur las rigs rkyang rgyas pa lnga/ /rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang bsdus pa lnga/ /mi bskyod he ru ka gsum yum gyi gnyis/ /dngos bstan nyi shu yod kyang man ngag gis/ /rigs gzhan bzhi la'ang sku gsung thugs sbyar bas/ /rigs lnga re re'ang bzhi bzhi nyi shu ste/ /rigs rkyang rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor nyi shu dang / /rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus nyi shu nyi shu la/ /yum gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis bsnan drug cu gnyis/ /yang na rigs bsdus rgyas bsdus gnyis yod ltar/ /rigs rkyang la yang rgyas bsdus gnyis sbyar bas/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis 'byung ba gur rgyan lugs/ /kha sbyor rgyud las dges pa rdo rje bzhi/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma/ /rdo rje dbyings dang drag po gdan can te/ /dngos su bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad 'byung la/ /rdo rje dbyings la gtso bo 'pho ba yi/ /gnad kyis rigs bsdus lnga ste bcu gnyis so/ /gal te rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rdo rje 'chang / /logs su bgrangs na kha sbyor nas bshad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'chang yang bgrang bar rigs she na/ /rtsa rgyud gsung ba'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang / /yin phyir de yi dkyil 'khor bgrangs pa ste/ /kha sbyor rdo rje dbyings kyis gsungs pas na/ /gang de nyid las logs su bgrang mi dgos/ /de ltar man ngag lugs kyi gsung sgros ni/

/gtsor byas dges pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsum nas/ /bshad pa'i mchog sgrub dkyil 'khor brgya phrag gcig /'byung ba 'di ni 'khrul zad gong ma'i lugs/ /gzhung 'grel ltar na rtsa bshad gsum ka nas/ /'byung ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams/ /dang po'i las pas bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor te/ /thun mong sgrub pa tsam du bzhed pa'ang yod/ /las rgyas sgrub pa'i lha yi rnal 'byor ni/ /rnal 'byor gang la rnam dag ma gsungs pas/ /tha mal snang zhen rtog pa mi sbyong yang / /zhi rgyas la sogs sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor/ /nyid yin rtsa ba'i rgyud las rdo rje ma/ /dkar mo chu ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdag med ma dang mkha' spyod sa spyod ma/ /rig byed ma ste rnam pa brgyad yod do/ /gur las 'byung po 'dul ba stobs po che/ /khro bcu so so rdo rje sgrol ma dang / /sher phyin dkar mo dang ni khro bcu spyi/ /rdo rje lus med ku ru kul+le dang / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs gshin rje'i gshed/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgrol ma 'od zer can tsun+da/ /nor rgyun ma dang rmugs 'dzin sor 'brang dang / /nag po chen po dang bcas nyi shu brgyad/ /kha sbyor rgyud nas sgrol ma rig byed ma/ /sher phyin dkar mo rigs bzhi yum bzhi dang / /mchog sgrub sgrol ma 'jigs byed 'od zer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can dang bde mchog dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshin rje'i gshed rta mgrin/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen rnam snang dang / /mkha' lding dbang gi sgrol ma dpal mchog dang / /ku ru kul+le nyi zla gzung ba dang / /sde gzhig pa dang lha dgas char dbab gcad/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor nam mkha' ste/ /thun mong sgrub pa gtsor gyur sum cu 'o/ /sgrub thabs sngon 'gro bsod nams tshogs gsag ni/ /tshad med bzhi tsam bya dang de'i sngon du/ /tshogs zhing mchod dang de steng rgyun bshags dang / /de bzhin sdom gzung bsnan pas rgyas bsdus bzhi/

/de rjes ye shes tshogs gsag srung 'khor bsgom/ /'bring du byed na khro bcu'i srung 'khor spong / /shin tu bsdu na tshad med bzhi tsam dang / /ye shes tshogs dang thun mong srung 'khor tsam/ /bsgoms nas rnal 'byor dngos la 'jug pa'ang rung / /gtso bo bskyed pa dang po sbyor ba dang / /mchod bstod yan chad dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ste/ /phra thig la sogs lhag ma las rgyal mchog /sku gsum lam byed ting 'dzin gsum gyi chings/ /gzhal med khang bskyed rnam par snang mdzad sku/ /rjes chags rdor sems ngo bo sgrub thabs gtso/ /sems nyid dag byed dbang bskur mi bskyod thugs/ /bdud rtsi mgrin par myang phyir dpag med gsung / /mchod pa sangs rgyas phrin las don yod grub/ /bstod pa yon tan ngo bo rin chen 'byung / /rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub thabs yan lag drug /lha bskyed bsnyen pa'i yan lag sku rdo rje/ /byin brlabs nyer sgrub yan lag gsung rdo rje/ /dgug gzhug sgrub pa'i yan lag thugs rdo rje/ /rgyas 'debs sgrub chen ye shes rdo rje ste/ /sku bzhi'i sgrub thabs bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi/ /'di ni sgrub thabs kun la khyab byed do/ /rigs bsdus rnams la chings gsum gang rung dang / /kha sbyor rdo rje dbyings la thog mtha' sbyar/ /rigs rkyang rnams dang yum la phyi ma gnyis/ /lhag ma kun la 'jug pa bsnyen sgrub bzhi/ /'di la mchod bstod spangs pas 'bring du 'gyur/ /thog ma rnams la ltos te rgyas par bshad/ /dbang bskur gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes gzhug /rnam gsum rim gyis phri la 'bring po dang / /bsdus dang bsdus pa phyi mar rim bzhin bzhed/ /bskyed chog mnyam sbyor gur dang sam+bu ṭa'i/ /rigs bsdus rdo rje 'chang la nges par 'jug /rigs rkyang rdo rje 'chang la 'jug pa'ang yod/ /rigs rkyang rnams dang yum la mi mnyam sbyor/ /sku gsung thugs gsum sa bon las bskyed dang /

/cho ga gsum dang mngon byang las bskyed sbyar/ /drag po gdan can snying po tshig tsam dang / /ye shes mkha' 'gro dbugs kyi spro bsdu las/ /'khor rnams phal cher mngal 'byin tshul gyis bskyed/ /'ga' zhig thugs ka'i gnas nas spro ba'ang yod/ /skye mched lha rnams snying po tshig tsam ste/ /lhag ma cho ga gsum sogs las bskyed do/ /rjes ni bzlas dang spyod lam kha zas dang / /khrus dang gtor ma thun mtshams bya ba dang / /nyal ldang mchog dman kun la thun mong ba/ /mchog la dag pa dran pa khyad par ro/ /gang la gnad du bsnun pas lus sems la/ /bde chen ye shes skyed cing lhar zhen gyi/ /rnam rtog gnyen por gyur pa rdzogs rim yin/ /de yi rtsa ba nang gi sdom pa yi/ /gnas ni lte ba'i am̐ dang rtsa 'khor rnams/ /ji snyed chos kun ji bzhin nang du sdom/ /mtshan rtog thams cad sdom zhing spong sems ldan/ /thabs ni phyag rgya'i lam dang gtum mo yis/ /bde bar gyur pa sdom pa'i ngo bo 'o/ /sa dang lam kun nang du bsdu ba'i gzhi/ /phung khams skye mched so gnyis nyon mongs lnga/ /thun mong la grags byang phyogs so bdun dang / /bskyed rim ltar na gzhal yas khang gi cha/ /lha dang sbyar na gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon byang rnam pa lnga/ /rdzogs rim rten la sbyar tshe rtsa so bdun/ /de bzhin yi ge khams dang rlung so bdun/ /brten pa de rnams las byung ye shes che/ /mthar phyin 'bras bu sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /phrin las rnam grol ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /mngon shes drug dang zag med yul drug dang / /stobs bcu ye shes lnga ste so bdun no/ /dkar nag tshes dang bco lnga'i mtshan char bcas/ /lug glang 'khrig pa kar seng bu mo srang / /sdig gzhu chu srin bum nya nyi zla 'dzin/ /thig le 'gog dang nam mkha' 'gog pa 'pho/ /so gnyis rtsa las gnyis bsdebs bcu bzhi dang / /gtso gsum gcig tu byas dang bdud 'dral ma/

/dbyangs yig byang sems dga' ba kun bcu drug /de dag gnas ni mthe bong byin pa brla/ /gsang cha lte cha snying cha nu ma'i cha/ /lkog ma lag mthil mchu dang mkhur chos dang / /mig dang rna ba klad pa g.yas cha dang / /ro ma kun 'dar de bzhin g.yon la'ang ste/ /kun gyi snga ma bco lnga lha mo dang / /bcu drug pa rnams he ru ka dpal gyis/ /sbyangs pas thabs shes zung du 'jug par 'gyur/ /pho mo'i dbye bas yar ngo mar ngo la/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong g.yas g.yon nas brtsams te/ /rim gyis 'phos nas dkar nag bco lnga'i nyin/ /pho mo'i g.yas g.yon ro rkyang steng du gnas/ /bco lnga'i mtshan mo gnyis ka'i spyi gtsug tu/ /aḥyig rnam pas thim 'gyur mar ngo bzlog /de rnams ngo bo byang sems shes pa'i rten/ /rnam pa ā li kā li'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /rang bzhin dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs bcu drug /rtsa gsum gtso mo gnyis gnyis 'khor gyi lha/ /bdud 'dral ma ni yab ste lug sogs so/ /de yang phyi rol rgyu skar nang gi rtsa/ /nyi zla khu khrag bgrod pa g.yas g.yon 'pho/ /de ltar zhag gis 'pho ba ma thub pas/ /tshes kyi lhag chad dag dang bshol 'byung zhing / /khu khrag 'dres las nyi zla gzas 'dzin dang / /khams kyi 'phel 'grib dbang gis dus 'byung ngo / /de ltar snang ba thog med 'khor ba yi/ /bag chags sems la gnas pa lus nyid la/ /rtsa yig sogs kyi rnam par smin pa'i mthus/ /med bzhin phyi rol don gyi snang ba shar/ /de lta'i byang chub sems las yon tan kun/ /'byung phyir mi spong thabs gnyis kyis bskyed bya/ /de ltar sgro 'dogs bcad nas bsgom pa'i thabs/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud las rtsa yig re re dang / /gur las thig le'i rnal 'byor gcig 'byung zhing / /yang dag sbyor bar thig le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /de bzhin rlung gi rnal 'byor mang du bshad/ /rtsa rgyud dang por gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi/ /gur las dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i zhar byung gcig

/kha sbyor rgyud las gtum mo nyer lnga dang / /gur las phra mo'i rnal 'byor gcig bshad do/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dmigs bcas skye ba'i rten/ /dbang lam 'bras bur lang tsho rigs yon tan/ /ma sring bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /zhang po'i chung ma ma spun sgyug mo dang / /pha yi sring mo zhes bya rnam pa brgyad/ /de bzhin bram ze rgyal rigs rje 'u mo/ /dmangs mo gar ma tshos ma g.yung mo dang / /gdol ma zhes bya brgyad yin phan tshun sbyar/ /de bzhin dbang gi sgo nas ma sogs brgyad/ /ye shes sgo nas bcu drug dag tu 'gyur/ /dgag bya'i dbang gis ye shes phyag rgya'ang bshad/ /bsten thabs 'du shes gsum ldan dbab gzung gnyis/ /de bzhin bzlog khyab gnyis yin byang sems gnas/ /nor bu'i dkyil du 'dzin 'dod mu stegs lugs/ /pad+mar phab pa tha mal pa dang mtshungs/ /ye shes don du 'dod la gnod byed yod/ /lhan skyes gsum par 'dod la lung 'gal dang / /skad cig dga' ba 'khor lo yas babs dang / /dbang dang dri ma khams gsum 'dod pa dang / /bsam gtan sa lam mas brtan phyag rgya dang / /'bras bu'i go rim 'khrugs pa'i gnod pa 'bab/ /de phyir gnas mchog mkha' gsang 'dzom pa'i rtser/ /ngo bo mthong lam mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes/ /go rim mtshan bral bzhi pa'i gnas skabs su/ /lhan skyes skye la klan ka'i go skabs ci/ /de lta'i thabs gnyis gang yang rung ba las/ /ye shes cung zad skyes pa la brten nas/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun/ /brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin bsgom par bya/ /gal te brjod med rang bzhin nyid yin na/ /sna tshogs snang ba 'di dag ci zhe na/ /kun rdzob tsam du sna tshogs su snang yang / /ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su/ /nges par byas la bsgom bya sgom byed sogs/ /blang dor dgag sgrub re dogs med par gzhag /de ltar mnyam gzhag dmigs med goms pa las/

/rjes thob dmigs dang bcas pa'i sems can la/ /smyo ba'i bu la ma rnams brtse ba ltar/ /bcos min snying rje ngang gis skye bar 'gyur/ /dmigs med nam mkha' bsgom pa'i sbyor ba dang / /mi g.yo bzhi ldan rnal 'byor la brten te/ /rtog med ting 'dzin bsgrubs nas yul kun la/ /bsres shing spos te 'dzin med lta ba bskyang / /gal te chos kun ngo bos ma grub na/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub phyir bzlas bsgom la sogs pa/ /thabs kyis ngal ba byed pa don med de/ /lha sngags don la med pa'i phyir zhe na/ /dam pa'i don du bsgrub bya sgrub byed sogs/ /yod pa min yang spros bral ngang nyid nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po yi/ /lha dang sngags sogs 'byung la skyon yod min/ /de phyir de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bzlas bsgom la sogs grol ba'i grogs su 'gyur/ /gal te de ltar bsgoms kyang chos rnams kyi/ /chos nyid nam yang shes par mi 'gyur te/ /yul dang chos nyid tha dad phyir zhe na/ /tha dad yod na de ltar 'gyur na yang / /snang ba sna tshogs lhan skyes ye shes dang / /chos nyid kyang ni rang las gzhan min phyir/ /thabs de chos nyid rtogs pa'i grogs su 'gyur/ /de ltar shes nas za 'chag la sogs kyi/ /spyod lam kun tu ting 'dzin dran byas pas/ /rmi lam sogs su'ang dran pa'i thabs su 'gyur/ /de lta'i sbyor bas gnas na yul rkyen gyis/ /mi gnod grol ba'i grogs byed dngos grub thob/ /'byung gdon ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad gsum/ /ting 'dzin nyid kyis sel bar byed pa ste/ /du ba la sogs rtags rnams myur du 'char/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pa las byung drod gsum ste/ /chos brgyad snyoms dang tshar gcad rjes gzung nus/ /de ma thob na brtson pas rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor bsgom dang kun 'dar gsang ste spyod/ /drag shul bsgrubs te slar yang zla phyed du/ /bsgoms nas drod dang spyod pa rim bzhin sbyar/

/de la 'jug tshe yo byad kun btang nas/ /blang dor med par spyad bya de la gnyis/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog spong ba kun 'dar dang / /rtogs pa ye shes skyong ba kun tu bzang / /gsang spyod sngon du song nas zla der spyod/ /'on kyang kun bzang lo zlar spyod pa'ang yod/ /khyad chos gnyis ldan sgrub pos de spyad na/ /rang gi sems kyi brtan g.yo nges sogs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thob phyir gnas skabs gsum char ram/ /gzhan du med kyang tha mar phyag rgya bsten/ /ngo bo ā li kā li'i byang chub sems/ /khyad chos brgyad dam drug gi bdag nyid de/ /gal te sems la rtog pa 'char ba ni/ lus la ltos pa mi rigs zhes smra na/ /lus sems lhan cig gnas pa de srid du/ /tshogs pa gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod phyir 'thad/ /kun bzang spyad nas sa lam lhag ma rnams/ /bgrod phyir nye rgyu'i spyod pa spyad bya ste/ /gang de zhag bdun gyis 'grub drug pa yi/ /srod la bar chad med pa'i bdud btul nas/ /bdun par song ba'i tho rangs rnam grol brnyes/ /de yi gnas ni thun mong thun mong min/ /nges pa'i don du rang nyid grol ba'i gnas/ /nang gi gnas ni e waṃ 'dzom pa'i rtse/ /phyag rgya ring nas goms dang grub pa thob/ /lung bstan nas mthus bkug pa'i mi nyid bsngags/ /de la thabs gnyis la brten byang sems kyi/ /dwangs ma mngon du byas pa las byung ba'i/ /thig le zla ba me long ye shes dang / /rak+ta nyi ma mnyam pa nyid ye shes/ /rlung sems ma 'dres yongs rdzogs so sor rtog /thams cad ro gcig bya ba nan tan che/ /g.yas g.yon dbus nas 'dren pa'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /thabs dang shes rab so sor dag byas te/ /dbu mar thim pas gtsug tor mchog grub pa'i/ /skad cig gcig la zag med 'ja' lus dang / /rtog med ye shes brnyes pa chos kyi dbyings/ /de lta'i rim pas rdo rje'i sa thob nas/

/'khor ba srid du 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'gyur/ /gnas skabs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa'i rim pa ni/ /sngags kyi ngo bo mtshan rtog kun las skyob/ /don gyi sngags ni rang sems lhan cig skyes/ /nang ltar bshad pa'i sngags ni lte ba'i am̐/ /phyi la dag par bya phyir btu ba dang / /dngos dang bzlas pa'i yul dang kha zas dang / /bzlas pa'i man ngag dag dang dgos pa 'o/ /gtor ma dus dang yo byad cho ga dang / /de yi dgos pa gnas skabs 'bras bu ste/ /cho ga rdzas dang mgron dang 'bul sogs dang / /mjug gi cho ga rnam pa bzhi yin la/ /re re'ang bzhi bzhir phye bas bcu drug go /sbyin sreg thab dang bud shing sbar ba me/ /mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas bsham thabs dus phyogs bcas/ /sgrub po'i khyad par rnam drug sbyor ba'i chos/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang / /thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod/ /'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos/ /me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma gtang / /tsā ru'i zas la longs spyod gshegs su gsol/ /smon lam gdab dang las rjes bsdu ba rnams/ /mjug gi chos te drug gsum bco brgyad do/ /rab gnas rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas/ /yo byad cho ga bzang po rnam drug las/ /cho ga sta gon dngos gzhi mjug gsum ste/ /re re'ang bdun bdun nyi shu rtsa gcig go /las tshogs rab 'byams dman 'bring 'bring gi mchog /dman pa rdzas sbyor 'khrul 'khor bzlas pa dang / /sbyin sreg bsam gtan rkyang pa'am tshogs pas bsgrub/ /'bring ni bzlas bsgom rdzas sbyor la sogs pas/ /'bring gi rab rnams bzlas bsgom tsam gyis so/ /de las zhi rgyas dbang drag yan lag bcas/ /mig sman rkang byug ral gri sa 'og sgrub/ /ril bu mi snang bcud len bu mo dgug /de dag spyi dang bye brag dbye bsdur bcas/ /mkha' spyod rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur rnams 'grub/

/dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs ni dam tshig ste/ /de yang dbang gis phye na rnam pa bzhi/ /rten gyi sgo nas sgo gsum dam tshig gsum/ /gang zag sgo nas bzhi'am gsum du 'gyur/ /dang po'i las pas rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang / /de yi yan lag brgyad de nyi shu gnyis/ /bsgrub pa'i dam tshig bcu bdun dang bcas bsrung / /bsrung tshul bsdu na sgo gsum dam tshig nyid/ /bza' ba'i dam tshig rgyun du bsten bya ni/ /tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu ste/ /de nyid shes pas bsten na mkha' 'gro mnyes/ /tshe dang lus kyi bcud len mchog tu 'gyur/ /khyad par can gyi bza' ba'i dam tshig ni/ /ya gyal tshogs na so so'i ston mo dang / /pho mo gnyis tshogs tshogs kyi 'khor lor brjod/ /dbang bskur rab gnas dang 'brel tsā ru'i zas/ /rnal 'byor mang tshogs mdza' ba 'dus pa dang / /lha grangs ltar 'khod sangs rgyas gar zhes bya/ /mchod bya'i sgo nas rigs ldan mchod pa dang / /gzhon nu'i ston mo zhes byar btags pa'ang yod/ /gang de dur khrod la sogs ches dben par/ /rgyun dang khyad par can gyi dus kyi tshe/ /mchod pa'i yo byad thabs shes rdzas sogs bcas/ /gang zag dam tshig rnam dag rnam rtog chung / /mtshan nyid dang ldan grogs dang bcas pa 'am/ /yang na drod rtags thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gnas khang brgyan te tshogs dang gtor ma bsham/ /slob dpon nang du byon nas sngon la bzhugs/ /sgo bas brda bya brda lan shes rnams gzhug /dbang sogs rim pas rgan gzhon gral rim bya/ /rnal 'byor mchog la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ /yig brgyas rgyud sbyangs srung 'khor bsgom pa drug /ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim/ /snying ga'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myang bas tshim/ /chos skyong 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshim/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor zas kyis tshim/ /skye mched lha rnams glu gar rol mos tshim/

/thabs shes snyoms 'jug bde bas tshim pa drug /byin gyis rlob phyir rdo rje'i glu len dang / /shis par bya phyir bkra shis tshigs bcad brjod/ /lhag gtor btang nas yig brgyas lhag chad bskang / /smon lam btab cing 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ /bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba dang / /bsrung ba byas nas las rjes bsdu ba drug /de ltar drug gsum bco brgyad tshogs 'khor gyi/ /dgos pa'i gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /gnas skabs dgos pa ci 'dod dngos grub 'grub/ /dam tshig nyams na bcas rang phra mo la/ /nyes pa'i tshogs las ldang ba'i cho ga dang / /chen por gyur na dam tshig sdom pa ni/ /tshul bzhin blangs la legs par bsrung bsdam bya/ /brtan pa thob pas gnyis spang spyod pa dang / /brtan pa cher thob 'khor 'das gnyis med du/ /spyod pa de dag so so'i dam tshig ste/ /spyod pa'i mngon rtogs nyid du bshad de 'o/ /de lta'i lam la slob pa'i gang zag ni/ /thun mong dbang drug tsam thob slob ma ste/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa slob dpon no/ /phyi la gzhol ba mngon rtogs bcu gcig po/ /legs par shes nas rang gzhan don du bsgrub/ /nang la gzhol ba mchog gi mngon rtogs dang / /dam tshig tsam la slob par byed pa mang / /yang rab tshe 'dir 'grub la bcud len dang / /rab kyis 'chi khar 'grub la 'da' ka ma/ /'bring gis bar dor 'grub la bar do'i lam/ /tha ma brgyud de 'grub la smon lam ste/ /'di dag 'ga' zhig nang gi las tshogs dang / /phal cher dam tshig nang du 'dus par bzhed/ /de ltar mos spyod gnas skabs mthar phyin nas/ /rtogs dang grub pas thob pa 'grub pa'i rgyu/ /kun bzang spyod pa lo zla sogs spyad nas/ /sa rnams bsgrubs te nye rgyu mngon du byed/ /de rnams dngos rgyu yul chen so gnyis kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi dbu mar thim pa ste/ /thog mtha'i sa bzhi yul chen bzhi bzhi dang /

/bar gyi sa brgyad de bzhin gnyis gnyis kyi/ /rlung sems thim las sa re'i rtogs pa skye/ /de rnams kun gyi stobs bsdoms dbu ma la/ /brten pa'i sbas pa'i rtsa lngas gtso byas te/ /spyi gtsug mchog tu thim pas bcu gsum pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur/ /rab dga'i sa la chos dbyings kun 'gro'i tshul/ /bdag med rtogs pa tshes pa'i zla ba mthong / /gnyis pa nas brtsams sangs rgyas sa yi bar/ /chos dbyings zla ba'i cha shas je gsal dang / /chos can rtogs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel 'gyur/ /rab dga'i rtogs pa skyes las grub pa'i rtags/ /ting 'dzin brgya1 thob de la snyoms par 'jug /sangs rgyas brgya mthong de yi byin rlabs rig /zhing brgyar 'gro zhing 'jig rten khams brgya bsgul/ /de brgya snang byed 'gro brgya smin par byed/ /bskal pa brgyar gnas sngon dang phyi mthar 'jug /chos brgya 'gyed cing lus brgya ston pa dang / /lus re'ang byang chub sems dpa' brgya phrag re'i/ /'khor gyis kun nas yongs su bskor ba ste/ /rab dga'i sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis/ /dus gcig nyid la yon tan de dag thob/ /gnyis pa nas brtsams bcu gnyis bar dag la/ /stong dang 'bum dang bye ba phrag brgya stong / /bye ba 'bum dang bye ba phrag khrig 'bum/ /'jig rten khams 'bum rdul snyed de bzhin du/ /grangs med 'bum phrag bcu yi rdul snyed dang / /thub pa'i zhing khams 'byams klas rdul gyi grangs/ /des kyang dpe byar mi nus yon tan dang / /de bas kyang ni gya nom yon tan thob/ /de lta'i sa la gnas sogs brda mdzad pa/ /phyi rol yul chen sum cu rtsa gnyis na/ /bdag rgyud byin rlob sprul pa'i sku rnams bzhugs/ /de bzhin nang na'ang so gnyis yul tshang zhing / /gang de'i rlung sems thim pas sa re re'i/ /rtogs pa skyes pa nang gi rten 'brel las/ /phyi rol yul na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/

/bdag gis dbang du gyur la de ltar btags/ /gnas sogs de dag rab dga' dri ma med/ /'od byed 'od 'phro sbyang dka' mngon du gyur/ /ring du song dang mi g.yo legs pa'i blo/ /chos kyi sprin dang dpe med ye shes che/ /rdo rje'i sa ste de rnams yon tan gyi/ /rten du gyur phyir sa 'am gnas zhes brjod/ /nye rgyu la brten 'bras bu'i ngo mtshar ltas/ /sa chen g.yo dang tshar gcod rjes gzung dang / /sku dang ye shes mngon du gyur sogs 'byung / /de yi ngo bo rnam grol chos sku dang / /rnam smin gzugs sku gnyis su nyan thos 'dod/ /mdo sde rgyan las ngo bo nyid sku rten/ /de la brten pa longs sprul gnyis zhes bshad/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi rjes 'brang 'grel byed 'ga'/ /spangs rtogs phun tshogs rang bzhin skye med kyi/ /mtshan nyid can ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /byang chub phyogs mthun la sogs sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan brgya dang zhe lnga chos kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan theg chen gyi/ /chos kyi longs spyod gzhir gyur longs spyod rdzogs/ /srid pa snyed du gang la gang 'dul gyis/ /'gro la phan mdzad sprul pa'i sku zhes gsung / /'ga' zhig chos sku mtshon par byed pa'i chos/ /mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas rnam bzhi zhes/ /rang lugs sku gsum nyid du bzhed pa'ang yod/ /byams pa'i rjes 'brang theg pa bsdus pa sogs/ /gzhan las kyang ni gsum gyi drang nges mdzad/ /'jug par skye 'gag la sogs kun zhi ba'i/ /gnas lugs skye med mngon gyur chos kyi sku/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku bsod nams brgya'i mtshan can/ /byang sems rnams kyi chos kyi longs spyod gzhi/ /gang de'i mthu yis sprul pa sna tshogs las/ /chos kyi sgra 'byung sprul pa'i sku zhes gsung / /sngags las longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor dang / /bde chen rang bzhin med dang snying rjes gang / /rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog med yan lag bdun/

/de yi rang bzhin med pa chos sku dang / /thog mtha'i gsum gsum longs sprul yan lag go /stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos bcas pa'i/ /bral 'bras sum cu gnyis ldan don dam sku/ /rnam smin 'bras bu mtshan bzang so gnyis kyis/ /legs par brgyan pa kun rdzob brda yi sku/ /spros pa kun bral chos kyi longs spyod gzhi/ /shes rab snying rje kha sbyor zag med bde/ /'gro don gzhir gyur phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /thugs rjes mi skyo dang po'i yan lag bdun/ /zhal phyag rang bzhin med dang 'og min bzhugs/ /zhal sbyor brda dang des mtshon bde chen brda/ /mchog dman don mdzad gang de rgyun mi 'chad/ /gdul bya 'gag med phyi ma'i yan lag bdun/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / /dam tshig sems dpa' snying po kyai rdo rje/ /rim bzhin chos longs sprul pa ngo bo nyid/ /sku gsung thugs dang snying po rdo rje bzhi/ /gzugs sogs phung po gnas gyur rigs lnga dang / /de bzhin nyon mongs gnas gyur ye shes lnga/ /dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi sku bzhi lus ngag yid/ /chos longs sprul pa yang na thog mtha' bzlog /kun gzhi'i chos nyid chos dbyings ye shes 'gyur/ /kun gzhi nyid ni me long lta bu ste/ /nyon yid mnyam nyid yid ni so sor rtog /sgo lnga'i rnam shes bya ba nan tan no/ /lus gnas gyur pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /brnyes nas yon tan phrin las rten gyur phyir/ /rgyal rnams ye shes sku dang ldan pa yin/ /lam gyi skabs su lus ngag las kun gyi/ /sngon du sems 'gro sems kyis dbang byas phyir/ /'bras dus sku nyid ye shes ches dbang mdzad/ /de bas sku dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i/ /mtshan nyid can du gyur phyir bem po min/ /mdor na bden rdzun spros pa dang bral zhing / /rgyu 'bras ngo bos stong yang gzugs brnyan ltar/ /gsal snang yod phyir rnam med ma yin la/

/mtshan dper bcas pa'i ye shes sku yin phyir/ /bem dngos ma yin de bzhin ye shes kyang / /brjod du med phyir bden dngos ma yin no/ /me long ye shes gzhan gyi rten yin te/ /ye shes gsum ni de la brten pa nyid/ /ye shes gang la chos kun gzugs brnyan gyi/ /tshul gyis snang phyir me long lta bu dang / /spang bya kun 'joms sangs rgyas sprul pa ston/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs phyir mnyam pa nyid/ /ji lta ji snyed chos kun ma 'dres par/ /so sor mkhyen nas ston phyir so sor rtog /dpag med sprul pas rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrub phyir bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes brjod/ /ye shes rnams dang dbyer med chos dbyings la/ /chos dbyings ye shes zhes byar sngags las bshad/ /thos 'dzin mnyam nyid sgom dang chos rab ston/ /sems can don sgrub ye shes 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /chos kyi dbyings dang ye shes rnam bzhi yis/ /sangs rgyas sa kun bsdus par mdo las bshad/ /me long mnyam nyid sor rtog longs spyod rdzogs/ /bya grub ye shes sprul skur rgyan las gsungs/ /kha cig me long chos dbyings chos sku ste/ /me long longs skur bshad pa rgyu la dgongs/ /sor rtog sprul skur 'chad pa'ang de bzhin no/ /sngags gzhung dgongs pa me long chos kyi sku/ /mnyam nyid sor rtog longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /bya grub sprul sku chos dbyings ngo bo nyid/ /gal te sems ni spros pa dang bral la/ /lus ni bem po yin phyir de gnyis kyis/ /shes bya rtogs pa rigs min de yi phyir/ /ye shes 'thad min zhe na sems nyid las/ /gzhan pa'i bem po zhes bya'i chos med cing / /sems nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes sku/ /ngo bo spros dang bral phyir 'gal ba med/ /chags pa zhes bya skye ba 'khor ba dang / /'jig pa zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa'i mthas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnon min shes rab kyis/ /skye 'jig ngo bos stong par rtogs phyir ro/

/gal te gzhan don 'byung dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /yon tan med 'gyur zhe na snying rje yis/ /zhi ba mya ngan 'das pa'i mtha' mnan phyir/ /sems can don dang sangs rgyas yon tan 'byung / /spros dang bcas 'gyur zhe na shes rab kyis/ /'khor ba'i mtha' kun mnan phyir spros las grol/ /de ltar snying rjes 'jig pa myang 'das dang / /shes rab chen pos chags pa 'khor ba ste/ /srid zhi gnyis ka'i mtha' la mi gnas pa/ /'di ni zung du 'jug phyir so sor med/ /de ltar srid zhi mnyam nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /rtogs dang rtogs bya dang bral mnyam nyid de/ /chos sku'i mtshan nyid nyi shu rtsa drug gis/ /bsdus nas gsungs kyang mtshan nyid kun gyi gtso/ /mkha' mnyam rnam rtog las grol gnyis med do/ /de ltar snying rjes 'khor ba mi gtong phyir/ /nam yang mdzad pa rgyun chad mi mnga' ste/ /chos sku mdzad pa'i rgyu yin longs sku ni/ /sa bcu'i byang sems don mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /mchog gis grub pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / /sprul pa 'bring gis nyan rang la sogs pa/ /tha mas gang la ci 'dul de la de'i/ /rnam 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas 'gro don mdzad/ /de ltar rang bzhin rnam dag rgyu yi chos/ /sbyong byed thabs kyis legs par sbyangs pa las/ /skyon bral 'bras bu'i chos su gnas gyur pa/ /de nyid sku ste sku nyid ye shes lnga/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas gzugs sku gnyis/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas ngo bo nyid/ /rtogs dang rtogs bya gnyis med chos kyi sku/ /de bzhin ye shes chos sku mdzad pa'i rgyu/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni mdzad pa po/ /sprul pa'i sku ni mdzad pa'i tshul yin la/ /ngo bo nyid sku mdzad pa'i ngo bo ste/ /mdzad pa po la skyo dub mi mnga' zhing / /mdzad yul 'gro la mu mtha' med pa'i phyir/ /mdzad dus nam mkha' gnas pa de srid du/ /mdzad tshul du mas 'gro don rtag mdzad de/ /sku yi rnam 'phrul ston pa lha dbang bzhin/

/gsung gis gdams ngag 'doms pa lha yi rnga/ /mkhyen brtse'i sprin las 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bebs/ /tshangs bzhin grangs med sprul pas 'gro don mdzad/ /ye shes snang ba nyi ma'i 'od ltar spro/ /dgos 'dod 'byung ba mi rtog nor bu'i thugs/ /gsung dbyangs sgra snyan lta bus dam chos ston/ /mkha' khyab sku ni 'dus byas gzugs dang bral/ /thugs rje'i sa 'dzin 'gro ba'i dge legs gzhi/ /rtag par 'byung ba rgyal ba'i phrin las so// ༈ /swasti pra dzā bh+yaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam mchog /rgyud gsum gsang ba ston mdzad bla ma rje'i/ /gsang gsum yon tan yid la dran pa'i blos/ /sgo gsum dwang bas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ /e ma rgyu rgyud nam mkha'i ngos yangs por/ /rnam dag spyod pa'i 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng / /bkod legs grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gling chen dbus/ /theg mchog lhun po rgyud sde'i bang rim can/ /smin byed mngon rtogs gser ri'i phreng mdzes dang / /mtha' bral lta ba'i rgya mtshos legs 'khyud der/ /bskyed rdzogs nyi zla'i 'od chags 'chi med grong / /gnyis med spyod pa'i khang mdzes drwa mig can/ /gang der nye rgyu'i bde la rnam rol ba'i/ /thun mong dam tshig dang bcas 'dod lha dang / /sa lam 'bras bu'i gzugs khams rim brtsegs steng / /phrin las skye mched mu bzhi'i bla khab can/ /de lta'i brtan g.yo kun khyab kyai rdo rje'i/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngo mtshar ltad mo ni/ /blta 'dod rnam dpyod gsal ldan 'ga' yod na/ /legs bshad 'phrul gyi me long 'di ltos shig /gang 'di sde snod kun gyi lde mig ste/ /sngags gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru chen yin/ /snyan brgyud kun gyi zab gnad 'di na yod/ /de phyir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i glegs bam yin/ /mang thos rnam dpyod lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor gyis/ /'dod dgu'i dpag bsam rin chen ljon shing las/

/mgyogs par btus pa'i legs bshad me tog phreng / /'dren mchog bla ma'i dbu la mchod par dbul/ /bdag gis 'dir 'bad 'di la nyes pa'i cha/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis gzigs gyur na/ /bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzod mdzad de/ /bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab stsal du gsol/ /legs par bshad pa'i dge dang dge gzhan bcas/ /legs tshogs bsags pa gang des bdag gzhan kun/ /legs pa'i mchog gyur rgyal ba'i sku thob nas/ /legs bshad 'byung gnas thub bstan rgyas byed shog /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa/ /brgyud par bcas pa'i gsung gi mdzod 'dzin zhing / /rnam dkar phrin las rtag tu skyong bar shog /ces rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po'i gsal byed gong ma'i dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba sngar byas zin pa las slar yang de gnyis ka'i tshig don gyi cha ha cang ma spros shing / shin tu bsdus pa ma yin par skabs su bab pa'i ngag gis legs par bshad pa/ ljon shing mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rin po che rnams sgo du ma nas dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i slad du/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rat+na war+dha'i zhal snga nas gtso bor smos pa'i chos bzhin du spyod pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin gyis legs par bskyangs pas/ chos 'di'i rigs su skyes pa shākya'i dge slong rgyud gsum smra ba dkon mchog lhun grub kyis rang lo bzhi bcu rtsa lnga lon pa lcags mo glang gi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e wam̐ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i skul ba po dang yi ge'i lhan cig byed pa po ni/
